text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
choice_data_list: Twin Turbo ran a great race too!
Let's look back on the race.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo thinks so too!
My engine got lots of action!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm gonna run even more amazingly
and take 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Eeeh! No, no, no, no waaaaay~~!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Are you lecturing me?
Turbo's gonna do what Turbo wants to do!
choice_data_list: Then, tell me your thoughts on today.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Just your impressions? Then that means no lecture, right!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Sure! Um, let's see, today's Turbo is~...

And so, Twin Turbo and I held a reflection session...
which was really just a recap of the race.
